review_basis.disposition: Reviewed the complete contiguous 1305-1306 ordinary-race family at true 4x and gameplay scale. Frame 1305 P1 reuses the already-approved 057E asset only under a byte-identical stock-pose proof. The distinct 0D69 P1 pose and shared P2 0544 pose preserve exact stock envelopes and contact anchors, remain coherent with the approved Racer HD material/crown/fork language, and pass the sequence-level temporal gate.
